news.title: California attorney general subpoenas Nvidia over chips, former CEO's affair
news.summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta has issued an investigative subpoena to Nvidia related to former CEO Jensen Huang's affair with a suspected Chinese spy. The California Department of Justice said Thursday it is asking Nvidia whether its advanced chips or confidential information may have gone to China and whether Nvidia misled investors and the public.

news.title: SpaceX lenders seek safeguards against Musk sending AI chips into space - FT
